steps.action: C31 guide step 1: Entities opens on Calendar; List shows the registry
steps.actual: Entities opened on Calendar with the Calendar link marked current; List reached the registry table with its Legal name column

steps.action: C31 guide step 2: Type filter narrows the registry and Clear all restores it
steps.actual: Type=Branch narrowed the registry from 50 to 1 rows; Clear all restored 50 rows

steps.action: C31 negative: Register refuses a blank Legal name with a visible outcome
steps.actual: Register with a blank Legal name kept the dialog open and showed "Name the entity — its registered legal name."; no Entity was created

steps.action: C31 guide steps 3-5: register an Entity with identity details, Status defaulting to Active
steps.actual: Status defaulted to Active; Register saved "Rev C31 legal_team_member RVVZOT" and its jurisdiction, registration no., tax ID, agent and address, and the registry link opened the new record

steps.action: C31 guide step 5: an Overview text field saves on blur and a selection saves on choice
steps.actual: Registered agent saved when focus left the field and Status saved on selection; both survived a reload

steps.action: C31 guide note: corporate Status Dormant does not archive the Entity
steps.actual: After Status Dormant the record carried no Archived mark and still offered Archive, so the corporate Status did not archive it

steps.action: C31 guide note: registering the same legal name again creates a distinct record
steps.actual: Registering "Rev C31 legal_team_member RVVZOT" a second time was accepted; the filtered registry showed 2 rows with that name pointing at 2 different records, so the first was not updated or merged (first row: Rev C31 legal_team_member RVVZOT Corporation Republic of Aldoria ALD-RVVZOT Dormant — )

steps.action: C31 prerequisite: create a disposable Contract to carry the parties
steps.actual: Created disposable Contract 45 to run the party steps against

steps.action: C31 guide step 1: Our entity records which of our Entities signs
steps.actual: Our entity saved "Rev C31 legal_team_member RVVZOT" and the choice survived a reload, keeping our own Entity distinct from the other side

steps.action: C31 guide steps 2-3: a new Counterparty is created from the picker and marked Primary
steps.actual: Create "Rev Cedar Supply LRVVZOT" added the new Counterparty to the Contract and the first one carried the Primary mark

steps.action: C31 guide note: the picker refuses a second record for an existing name, ignoring case
steps.actual: Typing "REV CEDAR SUPPLY LRVVZOT" offered no Create row, and the Counterparty already on the Contract was not offered again

steps.action: C31 guide steps 4-5: add a second party, Make primary, then take one off the Contract
steps.actual: Added Rev Birch Logistics LRVVZOT, made it Primary, then "Take Rev Birch Logistics LRVVZOT off the contract" removed it; Rev Cedar Supply LRVVZOT remained and took the Primary mark back, and Rev Birch Logistics LRVVZOT's shared record still existed
